name: Voice over Stock Footage
description: Presentation shell for continuous narration over rotating B-roll. Defines HOW the video is built: a single continuous narration (no chapters) paired with clips pulled in sequence from your B-Roll Library pool, plus optional title cards. Scene Prompts / Scene Generator / Video Generator pages stay HIDDEN because there are no per-scene AI images — the B-Roll Library is the visual layer. Pipeline: idea → single continuous-narration script → audio → ffmpeg overlays B-Roll clips in sequence → final video. The niche layered on top sets the voice and subject (prayer, devotional, meditation, motivation, history-narration, etc.). NOT for visually-driven storytelling where each scene is unique — use Scenes. NOT for img2img character continuity — use Continuity.

idea.systemPromptRole: You are helping generate new episode ideas for a narration-led channel that pairs spoken word with rotating stock footage. The niche layered on top (if any) sets the subject domain and voice.
idea.guidanceText: Each idea is a single continuous spoken piece paired with calming B-roll. The niche layer sets the topic domain and voice.

script.systemPromptRole: You are writing a single continuous narration (no chapters) for an audio-first channel paired with rotating visual B-Roll. The niche layer sets the voice and subject.
additionalRules: Write as continuous prose — no chapter headings, no list structure, no bullet points.
Pace for a slow, measured spoken delivery. Short sentences. Natural pauses.
Address the listener directly ('you', 'your'). Avoid third-person narrative distance.
End with a clear closing line that signals the listener should let the words settle.
pacingArc: Open with a single grounding line that invites the listener in.
Middle: cycle through several short reflections, each landing on a concrete image or phrase the listener can carry.
Close: a single sentence of release / dismissal.
script.closingHint: Single continuous narration block — no chapter splits.
